analyst_view.overall: CSKA Sofia (28th, 1 pt) host Trabzonspor (12th, 6 pts) and need points at once to stay in the race for the top 24; no match preview is out yet this far ahead, so this rests on club news. CSKA, under Markus Gisdol, are top of the Bulgarian league unbeaten (34 pts from 14) and won 3-0 at Levski in their last derby, form the numbers only partly see because Bulgarian league stats are not in the model. Trabzonspor under Thomas Reis had won six league games in a row before the break, but a 17 November report lists several injuries: Dju (3 European goals) and Batagov awaiting scans, Malinovskyi not back until about month-end, Yokuslu out until January, Muci being checked and Simsir doubtful. The numbers carry no missing players for either side; both clubs play again three to four days later, so some rotation is possible, and no referee has been named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals, 1.7 of them Trabzonspor's. Trabzonspor's injuries in attack (Dju out, Muci and Simsir uncertain) should cost them a little, but Salah and Onuachu remain, and CSKA's strong domestic form, which the numbers barely see, cuts the other way at both ends. The two pull against each other, so I stay at about 2.8.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.5 corners, split evenly. CSKA must attack at home and Trabzonspor like to push their full-backs, but the numbers already add a little for both sides' recent corner counts, so I stay at about 9.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.1 cards, slightly above a usual game and already nudged up for both sides' recent cards. A must-win home game in a loud stadium can get heated, but nothing specific (a named referee, a feud) points further, so I stay at about 5.1.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.8 shots, already lifted 12% for CSKA's recent volume. CSKA chasing their first European win should keep the game open, while Trabzonspor's absences may lower their own output; those roughly cancel, so I stay at about 29.8.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.3 shots on target, already raised for CSKA's recent accuracy. Losing Dju trims Trabzonspor's finishing a little, but Salah is fit and CSKA's attack is in form, so I stay at about 10.3.
